/* AUXILIARY FUNCTIONS */

        indexMat    <- 1;

        indexMat    <- 1;
        
        for(k in 2:a){

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Parser error playing around with user defined functions
parts:
Hi Jon,

We tend to track these sorts of issues on GitHub. We should have replied back with a link to the issue on this thread, but it just slipped our minds. This issue on our issue tracker is here: https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/723

If you're not familiar with issue trackers, things to note:
- status: open vs closed. If it's open, we're still dealing with it. If it's closed, it could either be fixed or not really something we can fix. In this case, it's fixed. (You can tell because there's a pull request involved.)
- milestone: v2.4.0. This indicates which build will include this fix. We haven't release v2.4.0 yet, so it's not publicly available.

We're actively working on v2.4.0 now. We hope it'll be out next week. We ran into some unexpected hardware problems.


Daniel

PS. "Stan" isn't all caps.
PPS. I'll try to be better about putting links to an issue if it gets created out of a discussion.
